description: Update a rule's fields and/or path. Optimistic concurrency via expected_version_id. Cloud-only.

allow_duplicate.description: Set true only when intentionally allowing another rule with the same name.

expected_version_id.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency token from the existing record. Pass it when available to avoid overwriting a newer edit.

move_to_path.description: Optional workspace-relative destination path such as /packages/app. Missing nodes are created when allowed by the backend.

patch.description: Fields to change. Omitted fields are left as they are, so send only what actually differs.

priority.description: Updated priority. Use high only when violating the rule causes real regressions.

scope_type.description: Updated rule scope: project, folder, or file_type.

rule_id.description: Rule UUID returned by pathrule_get_context, pathrule_goto, or pathrule_read_rule.

name: pathrule_update_rule

data.description: Updated rule: id, version_id, and the name it now carries.

error.description: Present only when ok is false.

code.description: Stable machine-readable failure code, for example insufficient_scope, workspace_id_required, rate_limited, not_found, or upstream_error. Branch on this, not on message text.

detail.description: Optional structured context for the failure, for example { missing_scopes: [...] } on insufficient_scope.

human_message.description: One-line summary of the result, safe to relay to the user verbatim.

ok.description: true when the call succeeded. false when it did not, in which case `error` carries the reason and the success fields are absent.

related_to_check.description: Up to 3 items that may need the same change (companions, links, near duplicates), from a cached knowledge map.

title: Pathrule Update Rule
